reason: The remote-access question reports that remote access is permitted but the list of accessible systems and access methods is missing, incomplete, or outdated. AR-18 specifically confirms that no maintained register pairs every remotely accessible target with its access method, so the self-report is consistent with, but narrower than, the documented deficiency. More decisively, AR-17 states that Aurora Grid maintains no current inventory of network flows between its network and information systems and the external environment that is approved by internal actors; its one-off description of the jump-host and legacy RDP paths is neither maintained nor internally approved. AR-13 likewise confirms that the current, internally approved asset, service, and application register contains no approved inventory of external network flows. Because an up-to-date, internally approved external-flow inventory is the central requirement of ID.AM-03_P1 and the evidence explicitly establishes its absence, the requirement is not satisfied.
